text: Gahh!
source_text: Gahh!

text: Well Gahh! back to you . . . I'm sorry that you never learned# to speak. We might have been good friends.

Well Gahh! back to you . . . I'm sorry that you never learned

text: Ouph.
source_text: Ouph.

text: I'm not feeling very well. Someone cracked my head# with a big pipe. I went to the medic but my head still# hurts. Sure hope someone catches the jerk that hit me.
source_text:
I'm not feeling very well. Someone cracked my head
# with a big pipe. I went to the medic but my head still
# hurts. Sure hope someone catches the jerk that hit me.

text: Why did they do that?
source_text: Why did they do that?

text: Guck.
source_text: Guck.

text: Well, they attacked me while I was here pretty late one night. Usually I go# home by eight or so, but I was staying late since someone had some water stolen and# I was checking our supplies. Next thing I know, I wake up in the med-lab with a# big bump on my head. Things are getting crazy around here.# Someone is going to get killed for water soon and I don't know what# we can do about it.
source_text:
Well, they attacked me while I was here pretty late one night. Usually I go
# home by eight or so, but I was staying late since someone had some water stolen and
# I was checking our supplies. Next thing I know, I wake up in the med-lab with a
# big bump on my head. Things are getting crazy around here.
# Someone is going to get killed for water soon and I don't know what
# we can do about it.

text: I'll see what I can do.
source_text: I'll see what I can do.

text: Sorry. I hope you feel better soon.
source_text: Sorry. I hope you feel better soon.

text: Here's your water.
source_text: Here's your water.

text: Here's your ration for today.
source_text: Here's your ration for today.

text: Hey! What do you think you're doing?!?
source_text: Hey! What do you think you're doing?!?

text: Please don't take so many supplies. We need those.
source_text: Please don't take so many supplies. We need those.

text: You log your reports in the library computer system. You should# return to the overseer to finalize your progress.

text: Hi. How have things been lately?
source_text: Hi. How have things been lately?

text: Say, what are you doing here?
source_text: Say, what are you doing here?

text: Well, everyone's pretty nervous, of course, but we haven't had too much# trouble. I hope you find a new chip soon.

Well, everyone's pretty nervous, of course, but we haven't had too much
# trouble. I hope you find a new chip soon.

text: I hand out the water rations, of course. And I make sure that nobody tries# to take more water than their share, though I don't think we'll have any trouble.

I hand out the water rations, of course. And I make sure that nobody tries
# to take more water than their share, though I don't think we'll have any trouble.

text: Hmm. Well, keep up the good work.
source_text: Hmm. Well, keep up the good work.

text: You too. I hope you find that chip soon so we can all go back to a normal# life.
source_text:
You too. I hope you find that chip soon so we can all go back to a normal
# life.

text: You're welcome to take supplies if you need them, since your job is so# important, but please don't take too much. We don't have much left.

text: 你看到一个负责分发水的警卫。
source_text: 你看到一个负责分发水的警卫。

text: 你好，
source_text: 你好，

text: 你好，近来如何？
source_text: 你好，近来如何？

text: 嘎！
source_text: 嘎！

text: 好吧！也送你一句问候……很遗憾你从未学过怎么说话，我们本可能会成为好朋友的。
source_text: 好吧！也送你一句问候……很遗憾你从未学过怎么说话，我们本可能会成为好朋友的。

text: 哦呜。
source_text: 哦呜。

text: 我感觉不太好。有人用根大管子打爆了我的头。我去治疗过，但我的头还是很痛。希望有人能逮到那个打我的混蛋。
source_text: 我感觉不太好。有人用根大管子打爆了我的头。我去治疗过，但我的头还是很痛。希望有人能逮到那个打我的混蛋。

text: 他们为什么那样做？
source_text: 他们为什么那样做？

text: 咕。
source_text: 咕。

text: 我是在深夜执勤的时候在这被袭击的。一般我都八点左右回家，但自从发生偷水事件后，我就会在这里多值会儿班，那时候我正在查库房。突然我就什么都不知道了，我醒来的时候在医疗室里，头上有个大包。这事情越来越疯狂，这样下去很快大概就会为水而出人命案了，我不知道我们该怎么办。
source_text: 我是在深夜执勤的时候在这被袭击的。一般我都八点左右回家，但自从发生偷水事件后，我就会在这里多值会儿班，那时候我正在查库房。突然我就什么都不知道了，我醒来的时候在医疗室里，头上有个大包。这事情越来越疯狂，这样下去很快大概就会为水而出人命案了，我不知道我们该怎么办。

text: 我看我能做些什么。
source_text: 我看我能做些什么。

text: 我很遗憾，我希望你很快就能好起来。
source_text: 我很遗憾，我希望你很快就能好起来。

text: 这是你的水。
source_text: 这是你的水。

text: 这是你今天的定额。
source_text: 这是你今天的定额。

text: 嘿！你在干什么！？
source_text: 嘿！你在干什么！？

text: 请不要拿走太多补给，我们需要这些。
source_text: 请不要拿走太多补给，我们需要这些。

text: 你在图书馆计算机系统里更新了你的报告。现在你应该去见所长汇报一下你的进度。
source_text: 你在图书馆计算机系统里更新了你的报告。现在你应该去见所长汇报一下你的进度。

text: 日安，
source_text: 日安，

text: 你好，最近怎么样？

text: 你在这儿干什么？

text: 还好，只是每个人都很紧张，当然，到目前为止还没发生什么大事。不过我仍然希望我们很快就能找到那个新的净水芯片。
source_text: 还好，只是每个人都很紧张，当然，到目前为止还没发生什么大事。不过我仍然希望我们很快就能找到那个新的净水芯片。

text: 我在早晨按定额分配水。尽管我认为我们短时期内还不会有什么麻烦，但我还是要确保按定额分发水。
source_text: 我在早晨按定额分配水。尽管我认为我们短时期内还不会有什么麻烦，但我还是要确保按定额分发水。

text: 嗯，继续工作吧，祝你好运。
source_text: 嗯，继续工作吧，祝你好运。

text: 你也是，我希望你很快就能找到净水芯片，那样这里的生活就能恢复正常了。
source_text: 你也是，我希望你很快就能找到净水芯片，那样这里的生活就能恢复正常了。

text: 你的工作更重要，如果你需要补给就拿吧，不过别拿太多，我们剩下的不多了。
